svg.title: A-200 Section A–A — Detached Villa
svg.text: External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Final draft — layout agreed. Looking west, cut on the line
marked A–A on every plan, at x 20.70. That line is not
arbitrary: it is the one north-south cut that passes
through a room at every level and through every wet room
in the east strip, and it clears all three column lines,
so the slabs are seen spanning rather than a column
2. The wet rooms on the first and second floors sit one over
the other, wall for wall — 8.60, 10.30 and 12.42 on both —
so each drops a single drainage stack straight to the
ground. The third floor divides the strip on its own lines
and is shown as it is.
3. Flat slab on the column grid, 300 mm structural zone,
giving 3.00 m clear at every level and 3.30 m floor to
floor; the penthouse is 3.25 m floor to top of slab.
4. The south cantilever is carried on all three upper floors
and the penthouse. It projects 1.85 m at this cut, against
1.95 m at each end of the curve and 1.35 m at its waist,
with a glass balustrade at the slab edge.
5. The penthouse stands clear of the north edge, leaving the
roof terrace beyond its north wall. The corridor that
joins the two terraces runs west of this cut and does not
6. The stair is drawn in thin line beyond the cut, where it
is seen through the open spine. Foundations are indicative
only and subject to a ground investigation and the
Final draft — layout agreed with the client; not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
